speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe your symptoms in detail, specifically regarding the fever, flank pain, and fatigue you mentioned, and tell me if you have noticed any changes in your urine.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the update. Since your symptoms persisted after treating the sinus infection, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood, cloudiness, or a foul odor? Also, does the pain in your side worsen when you press on it?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: That reaction to both amoxicillin and cephalexin is concerning; did the flank pain and fever return immediately after starting the cephalexin? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis AND Urine_Culture. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis.

The urinalysis showing leukocyturia with a negative bacterial culture and, crucially, the presence of 3% binucleated eosinophilic cells (eosinophils) confirms an allergic or hypersensitivity reaction to the antibiotics you took for your sinusitis, rather than a standard bacterial kidney infection.
